title: TeleportMarker
description: The Teleport Marker plugin allows players to create temporary teleportation markers that other players can use. You can set a teleportation marker at a specific location, with the option to set a duration for the marker and whether it can be used multi.
body:
## Teleport Marker **Teleport Marker** - is a convenient plugin for Minecraft servers that allows players to set temporary teleportation points. These points can be used by all players to quickly move to the specified coordinates. The plugin is ideal for creating temporary assembly points, event locations, or any other common locations where teleportation needs to be organized for a certain period of time. ![d](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1ZK4vRHi/images/df5cee2ba990c6c2d6162e832ce6dffd61f1b587.gif) ## The plugin provides the following commands: | **Command** | **Permission** | **Description** | |-------------------|:------------------:|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | /setmark \ \ \ \ \ | teleportmarker.use | Creates a new teleportation marker at the specified coordinates. The player can set:
- \ \ \ - the coordinates of the marker location
- \ - the time in seconds after which the marker will expire
- \ - determines if the marker can be used multiple times (true) or only once (false) | | /delmark | teleportmarker.use | Removes the active teleportation marker teleportation marker | | /gotp | - | Teleports the player to the active | | /tpmhelp | - | Displays help information about the plugin | ## Permissions: - teleportmarker.use - Allows the use of all plugin commands - teleportmarker.admin - Allows you to use all the commands of the plugin while being an operator. ## The Teleport Marker plugin provides administrators with a convenient way to create temporary teleportation points that can be used by the entire server community.
